description.en: Real-time animated charts for React. Line, multi-series, and candlestick modes, canvas-rendered at 60fps, zero CSS imports.
description.zh: 面向 React 的高性能实时流式动画图表库：Canvas 60fps 极速渲染，支持单线、多序列与 K 线模式，零 CSS 导入。

content.en: Liveline is an ultra-fast, canvas-based charting library designed specifically for streaming, real-time telemetry and financial data in React applications. Rendering at a consistent 60 frames per second on HTML5 Canvas, it handles continuous append streams without DOM thrashing or memory leaks. It offers multiple visualization modes—single series, overlaid multi-series, and financial candlesticks (OHLC)—complete with smooth momentum scrubbing, interactive crosshair overlays, and zero CSS dependencies.
content.zh: Liveline 是一套专为流式遥测与高频金融行情数据设计的 React 实时 Canvas 图表库。底层完全基于 HTML5 Canvas 实现原生 60fps 硬件加速渲染，彻底杜绝高频数据追加导致的 DOM 重排与卡顿。开箱支持单折线、多序列混合折线与蜡烛图（OHLC）模式，自带惯性滑动、带磁吸反馈的十字辅助准星、动态时序视窗调节，且无需导入任何外部 CSS 文件。
